items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Retirement plan eligibility is different: an employee may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one
- Check MosaicOne Benefits when coverage begins

Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for bulk personal-data extracts over email alone. Genuine internal requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Recommendation — not company policy: If you have any doubt about whether a message is legitimate, contact it-security@mosaicrobotics.example to ask how the policy applies to your situation.

Next steps:
- Forward to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Contact IT Security if unsure

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance; they are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claims by 20th of month for same-month reimbursement

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement.

Parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service. An employee who becomes a parent before reaching six months receives the statutory entitlement their jurisdiction provides, and the company benefit begins the day the service requirement is met.

An employee who gives birth also receives any period of medical disability leave certified by their clinician before the parental leave begins. The disability period is paid through short-term disability rather than as parental leave, and it does not reduce the 16 weeks.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations to request parental leave
- Review eligibility and service tenure requirements

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering the room rate only. Local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates. MosaicOne Travel applies the higher cap automatically for those markets.

Where the cap cannot be met—a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market—you book the most reasonable available option and note the reason. No pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Check MosaicOne Travel for your destination's cap
- Note the reason if you exceed the cap

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Work performed outside the home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside the home country.

The employee must hold the right to work in the destination country for the whole of the requested period. Mosaic Robotics will confirm employment and provide a letter of assignment but will not sponsor a visa for temporary work abroad.

Public and hotel networks are treated as hostile. Always-on VPN, screen locks and physical device custody rules apply in full and are not relaxed because the employee is on approved travel.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review 21 days before departure
- Obtain director and manager approvals
- Notify IT Security 5 business days ahead

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports USD 2,501 to USD 10,000 require director approval and a Finance business partner review.

Recommendation — not company policy: Ensure all receipts of USD 25 or more are itemised, book flights at least 14 days ahead, and submit the expense report within 45 calendar days of each transaction date.

For a USD 3,000 conference trip, your director (Dana) will approve the spend, with a Finance business partner also reviewing it.

Days since the transaction: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Next steps:
- Book flights 14+ days before departure.
- Collect itemised receipts for expenses ≥USD 25.
- Submit expense report within 45 calendar days.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

The full required training set for every employee includes security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one, and an employee has 30 days from the end of the 90-day waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Standard equipment—laptop, power adapter, headset and laptop bag—is shipped to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. For remote hires, the shipment also includes monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Finish all required training by day 30
- Make benefits elections within 30 days of day 90

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

A refresh that falls due on the cycle is an IT ticket and nothing else: no spending approval is raised, whatever the replacement machine costs, because a refresh replaces standard issue rather than adding to it.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment.

Next steps:
- Confirm refresh timing with IT when ticket opens
- Copy personal files before returning device

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Formal investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours. Severity 1 covers immediate risk to a person: violence or a threat of it, a safety incident with injury, a credible risk of self-harm, sexual misconduct involving physical contact, and any matter where someone must be separated from a situation today.

Response means a named human being contacting the person who raised the case, acknowledging what was raised, naming who owns it and describing what happens next.

Next steps:
- Contact Employee Relations if you have a concern to report.
- Review the Workplace Conduct Policy for reporting channels.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on your office calendar.

Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, earning 18.0 days across a full plan year. The service band is evaluated on the posting date using your most recent hire date; a promotion, transfer or change of manager does not reset it.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own; the approval must be recorded against the request so the audit trail is complete.

PTO requests of any length are approved by your direct manager. Longer requests and requests overlapping a blackout period additionally require director approval.

Escalation: To retrieve your current PTO balance, contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example.
